<!--
Four admission tests, all of which have to pass. .github/CONTRIBUTING.md states
them in full.

  It was found, not sought.       Went looking? That is work/research/.
  It is a discrepancy.            Names what it disagrees with.
  Fixing it now would derail you. A two-line fix is a fix, not an issue.
  Re-finding it would cost work.  A number a command prints needs no issue.

The title names the discrepancy, not the symptom, as a sentence:
"Three rounds break the energy-tower skill claim".

An issue has no owner and no priority. Leave labels and assignees empty.
-->

**Found.** While <what you were doing when it surfaced>.

**Observed.** <The measurement, with the numbers in it.> Reproduce with:

```
<the command, and enough of its output to read>
```

**Contradicts.** <The document, assertion or commit this disagrees with, by
name. If the belief was never written down, say so in as many words: an issue
whose expectation is unstated cannot be closed.>

**Walked past because.** <What chasing it would have derailed.>

**First thing to check.** <Optional. The cheapest thing that would move this,
so the next reader does not restart from the beginning.>
